text.description: The operator's steer text. Required; non-empty after trim.

description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/runs/{runId}/steer` (add-orchestra §1 — Baton).
Carries the operator's steer text — the same text the live
`WorkerCommandHandler` appends to the worker's
`comuki-injected-context.md`, and the same text the Phase 1a
follow-up WorkItem's `brief` reproduces. The follow-up is the
no-LiveSession runtime's only way to surface the steer to a fresh
worker after the reaper reclaims a dead lease.
